blocks.text: All numbers come from `params/param_<domain>.m` (structure, power, drive, electronics, rc, sensors, gnc, sim, world). Edit the file, then reload the parameters before the next run:

shaddad_params();                        % reload P after editing a param file
P.electronics.rcmap.deadband = 0.08;     % quick test: base workspace only, not saved
If you change model structure (blocks, wiring), change the build script and regenerate only the affected part:

build_drive({'esc'});          % regenerate one drive file
build_shaddad_mcu('model');    % regenerate the MCU model only
Do not run `build_shaddad_mcu()` or `build_shaddad_mcu('all')`: they overwrite the finished firmware units with stubs.
